notes.title: Welcome Players! 🚽
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Welcome to the Toilet Empire! 🚽💰[/b] 

It’s time to build and manage your very own sanitation empire! 🪠 

From tiny portable cabins to luxurious VIP restrooms, you’re in charge of keeping your customers happy, your facilities spotless, and your profits flowing. 🏗️✨[/h3]

In Toilet Empire, you'll start small but quickly expand into a massive business. Invest in high-tech restrooms, upgrade your cleaning systems, and deal with all sorts of unexpected challenges - because running a toilet empire is no easy job! Will you go for practicality and efficiency, or will you create the most extravagant restrooms the world has ever seen? The choice is yours!

[h3][b]If you haven’t seen the latest trailer yet, check it out now and… keep reading until the end! 👀[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=71NYf7E93-8;full][link yt][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Here’s how you can get involved:[/b][/h3]

1️⃣ Add Toilet Empire to Your Steam Wishlist – Stay updated on all news, updates, and announcements as we get ready for launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541770/Toilet_Empire/

2️⃣ Join Our Community! – Share your ideas, give feedback, and be part of shaping the future of the Toilet Empire. Your input matters!

[url=https://discord.gg/5SZQmJXs6p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545824/bccddd23f824c6c2d5a34c678b94a1aaae98033d.png[/img][/url]

We can’t wait to see how you build and manage your ultimate toilet empire! 🚽🏆


See you soon,
The Toilet Empire Team
